name: termometro-de-equipo
description: Termómetro de Equipo — diagnóstico de clima de equipos

scripts.dev: npm run setup:dev && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names API,WEB --prefix name "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @termometro/shared && npm run build -w @termometro/api && npm run build -w @termometro/web
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names API,WEB --prefix name "npm run start:api" "npm run preview:web"
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build && npm run build -w @termometro/desktop
scripts.desktop: npm run build:desktop && npm run start -w @termometro/desktop
scripts.package:win: npm run build && npm run package:win -w @termometro/desktop
scripts.local: npm run setup:dev && npm run build && npm run start:api
